Prosperz Salon truly stands out as the best salon in Kurla West, and I’m delighted to share my exceptional experience. Time is a precious commodity, and Prosperz Salon ensures you get the most out of your visit without compromising on quality.

The stylist’s professionalism and skill were evident right away. Despite the speed, every detail was attended to with care, leaving me thoroughly satisfied with the results. What sets this salon apart is the valuable suggestions the stylist provides. They genuinely listen to you, understanding your preferences and concerns, and then recommend solutions tailored to your needs. It’s rare to find such personalized advice that makes you feel heard and confident in the choices being made.

The staff’s behavior is another highlight. Their warm and courteous approach instantly puts you at ease. It’s clear they prioritize customer satisfaction, creating a welcoming and friendly environment that makes you want to return.

Overall, Prosperz Salon is a gem in Kurla West, delivering top-notch service, exceptional results, and a wonderful customer experience. If you’re looking for a salon that combines speed, quality, and professionalism, this is the place to go. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: shabista qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I actually wanted to share my worst experience here with Imran, which I have never had in my life. I usually go to salons for haircuts and hair coloring, but this was by far the worst and most unprofessional experience ever.

I entered the salon at around 12:30 PM and only came out at nearly 9:30 PM. The way the staff behaved was completely intolerable. From the very beginning, the salon lady used the same pitch with every customer. I noticed her saying the exact same thing to others as well: “Ma’am, you already have color in your hair, we need to remove that first and then apply the new color.”

However, I never saw any proper process of color removal being done. It was simply repeated application of hair color. When I initially refused, she kept insisting, saying, “Don’t worry, you’ll get a very nice hair color, you’ll love the outcome.”

After starting the process, they repeatedly applied color and washed my hair nearly five times, which made my hair condition even worse. Even after 10 days, my hair is in such bad condition that I can hardly comb it. It has become extremely rough, almost like rope.

Also, as part of their marketing, they have a lady already sitting there just to ask customers for reviews. I honestly don’t understand the need for that. Please don’t go only by their reviews. The staff behavior is totally weird, and they even fight over their personal issues in front of customers without any professionalism.

I am really very disappointed. Trust me, guys, they are only focused on selling expensive treatments and convincing customers to go through unnecessary processes, without caring about the damage caused. I'm repenting go here :(

featured_reviews.name: Dixita Gujaran
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst salon experience of my life. Avoid at all costs.

We walked in at 11:00 AM and were trapped there until 12:30 AM, only to leave deeply disappointed. Despite giving clear reference photos and explicit instructions for my bridal hair, the end result was a joke. I asked for a color that would stand out—what I got was something that looked almost plain black. After wasting an entire day, the outcome was embarrassingly basic.

The owner’s/ partners behavior made the experience even worse. There was blatant favoritism in how customers were treated. We were asked to order and pay for our own lunch, while other clients were comfortably served dinner. Not once during this exhausting 13+ hour ordeal did anyone bother to offer us water, tea, or coffee—basic human courtesy, apparently optional here.

For a bridal service, this level of unprofessionalism is shocking. Zero hospitality, zero accountability, and results that don’t even come close to what was promised. Time wasted, money wasted, and stress added on what should have been a special experience.

Do yourself a favor and go literally anywhere else.

featured_reviews.name: aditya billore
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been coming to Zorro Salon for almost a year and honestly, the service has gone from one of the best to absolutely disappointing.

I’ve been paying ₹300 for every haircut consistently because I believed the service quality justified it. But from the last 2 visits, the experience has been terrible. The biggest issue is that they keep changing staff every 2–3 months. Instead of retaining experienced and skilled hairstylists, they keep hiring inexperienced people who don’t even understand basic hair styling.

My latest experience was the worst. The guy literally started cutting my hair without asking a single question:

No discussion about the style I wanted

No understanding of my hair type

No suggestions

No confirmation before cutting

No feedback during or after the haircut

It felt like they just wanted to finish the haircut as fast as possible and move to the next customer. A proper haircut takes time, attention, styling, and communication. Even normal salons ask customers what kind of look they want. Here, whoever is free just starts cutting your hair randomly.

This is not the kind of service expected from a salon that claims to be professional. The customer experience has become extremely poor and careless. Old customers clearly don’t matter anymore.

Never expected such low-quality and rushed service from this salon. Looks like it’s time to find a better salon that actually values customers and knows what professional grooming service means.

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Bharadwaj
featured_reviews.review_text: Forcefully overcharging after the service, the hair dressers are always pitching more expensive services. The lady at the front thinks she's too smart, she tried charging me for full length hair spa. When I told her I got haircut first, she confirmed it with the hairdresser and still charged me for a medium length hair spa, even though I cut my hair SHORT (above shoulder level), her stupid explanation to this is that the volume of my hair is dense so she needs to charge for medium. Which I think should be informed to client before the service. She started arguing and behaving rudely. Very disrespectful. Looks like they don't want repeat customers. I was a very loyal customer of Zorro for atleast 6 years now, but never visiting them again. You need to learn to value your customers. DO NOT VISIT. ITS BECOME A SAD MONEY MONGERING BUSINESS.

featured_reviews.name: sneha satishm
featured_reviews.review_text: ​I had a wonderful experience for my recent hairwash and haircut. My stylist was highly professional and clearly very skilled, delivering a cut that truly exceeded my expectations—I absolutely love it! Beyond the great haircut, the entire staff was so friendly and welcoming, and the salon itself had a wonderfully calming atmosphere. It was a truly relaxing visit from start to finish.

featured_reviews.name: Aaheli
featured_reviews.review_text: This salon overcharges significantly for basic services. I went in for a few services, and the prices were completely outrageous. They try to sell you every service they have, even if you say no.  I went in for a pedicure and had some hair growth on my legs. The staff took this opportunity to try to sell me their waxing services and made sure to make me feel bad about using a razor. People were looking at me cause the girl who was doing my pedicure showed my legs to another staff member. They charged 1200 for the pedi and did an OK job. They also kept pointing out my acne and other insecurities for their benefit. This is unacceptable. Next time, do what the customer tells you to do! Don't try to act smart.
